theorems.name: Submission.cbrr_tcd_plane_closedBall_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → μHE[n] ((Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ closedBall 0 r) = ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n) * unitBallVolume n
